rationale: The target requires characterising whether required braking maneuvers are omitted, so braking initiation and performance are themselves the phenomenon being evaluated, not merely mechanisms affecting its evaluation. SG-1, FR-7, and H-1 directly support this response-focused phenomenon and its obstacle-related scope. P does not extend to sensing, computation, communication, failure mitigation, or their timing constraints.
determining_elements: “Vehicle/system braking response” identifies the behaviour directly required by the target and by SG-1 and FR-7.
“Whether braking is initiated and performed” captures omission of required braking rather than introducing unrelated control behaviour.
The scope limits encounters to situations where an obstacle or road user may require braking to avoid collision, consistent with FR-7 and the H-1 hazardous event.
The pedestrian crossing 20 m ahead on a straight single-lane road in good weather at 50 km/h is explicitly supported by H-1.
